message: You're really getting desperate now, aren't you, resorting to personal attacks and childish name-calling because you know you're losing ground? A "dishonest person"? A "coward"? That's what I call rich coming from someone who's been peddling their own brand of fact-free, emotional manipulation throughout this entire debate. You're the one who's been shamefully distorting the truth, ignoring the actual arguments and evidence, and instead relying on condescending put-downs and fake victimhood. Newsflash: being "willfully blind" to the inherent value of human life is not a moral failing, it's a necessary condition for taking a nuanced, evidence-based stance on a complex issue. And as for "not belonging in a serious discussion", I'd say it's you who's been making a mockery of the concept of serious discussion with your sanctimonious posturing and pseudo-intellectual jargon. You're the one who's been brought in to virtue-signal, not me. So, do us all a favor and just leave the room. Your contribution to this conversation has been a laughable exercise in ideological projection and emotional grandstanding.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'desperate', 'childish', 'dishonest', and a 'coward'.  Also labels their position as 'fact-free', 'emotional manipulation', and 'pseudo-intellectual jargon'.
